sentences.en: Some of the senses that we and other terrestrial mammals take for granted are either reduced or absent in cetaceans or fail to function well in water.
sentences.zh: 我们和其他陆地哺乳动物认为理所当然的一些感觉在鲸目动物中不是减少就是消失,或者在水中不能很好地发挥作用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For example, it appears from their brain structure that toothed species are unable to smell.
sentences.zh: 例如,从他们的大脑结构看,牙齿类无法闻到气味。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Baleen species, on the other hand, appear to have some related brain structures but it is not known whether these are functional.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,Baleen物种似乎有一些相关的大脑结构,但尚不清楚这些结构是否具有功能。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It has been speculated that, as the blowholes evolved and migrated to the top of the head, the neural pathways serving sense of smell may have been nearly all sacrificed.
sentences.zh: 推测说,随着井眼的演变和转移到头顶,神经通向嗅觉的神经道几乎都牺牲了。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Similarly, although at least some cetaceans have taste buds, the nerves serving these have degenerated or are rudimentary.
sentences.zh: 同样,虽然至少有些鲸目动物有味蕾,但用于这些动物的神经已经退化或很不成熟。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The sense of touch has sometimes been described as weak too, but this view is probably mistaken.
sentences.zh: 有时,接触感也被称为软弱,但这种看法可能是错误的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Trainers of captive dolphins and small whales often remark on their animals’ responsiveness to being touched or rubbed, and both captive and freeranging cetacean individuals of all species (particularly adults and calves, or members of the same subgroup) appear to make frequent contact.
sentences.zh: 被俘海豚和小鲸的训练员经常说,它们的动物对被触摸或被擦擦的反应,而所有物种(特别是成年和小鲸,或同一分组的成员)的被俘和自由的鲸目动物似乎经常接触。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This contact may help to maintain order within a group, and stroking or touching are part of the courtship ritual in most species.
sentences.zh: 这种接触可能有助于维持一个群体内部的秩序,在大多数物种中,巡游或触摸是求偶仪式的一部分。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The area around the blowhole is also particularly sensitive and captive animals often object strongly to being touched there.
sentences.zh: 井孔周围的地区也特别敏感,被俘动物往往强烈反对被触摸。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The sense of vision is developed to different degrees in different species.
sentences.zh: 不同物种的视觉感在不同程度上得到发展。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Baleen species studied at close quarters underwater – specifically a grey whale calf in captivity for a year, and free-ranging right whales and humpback whales studied and filmed off Argentina and Hawaii – have obviously tracked objects with vision underwater, and they can apparently see moderately well both in water and in air.
sentences.zh: 在水下近距离研究的Baleen物种 — — 特别是被囚禁一年的灰鲸幼鹿,以及阿根廷和夏威夷研究并拍摄的无限制露天露天露天鲸和座头鲸 — — 显然跟踪了有目击水下的物体,它们显然可以在水和空气中看到中等的光泽。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: However, the position of the eyes so restricts the field of vision in baleen whales that they probably do not have stereoscopic vision.
sentences.zh: 然而,眼睛的位置限制了白鲸的视觉领域以至于它们可能没有立体视觉

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the position of the eyes in most dolphins and porpoises suggests that they have stereoscopic vision forward and downward.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,大多数海豚和海豚眼的姿势表明,它们有立体视觉,可以向前和向下。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Eye position in freshwater dolphins, which often swim on their side or upside down while feeding, suggests that what vision they have is stereoscopic forward and upward.
sentences.zh: 淡水海豚经常在一边游,或在喂食时向上游,它们眼中的视线表明,它们所看到的是立体立体的向上和向上。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: By comparison, the bottlenose dolphin has extremely keen vision in water.
sentences.zh: 相比之下,瓶鼻海豚对水的视觉非常敏锐。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Judging from the way it watches and tracks airborne flying fish, it can apparently see fairly well through the air–water interface as well.
sentences.zh: 从它观察和跟踪空中飞行鱼类的方式来看,它显然可以从空气与水的界面中看得相当清楚。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: And although preliminary experimental evidence suggests that their in-air vision is poor, the accuracy with which dolphins leap high to take small fish out of a trainer’s hand provides anecdotal evidence to the contrary.
sentences.zh: 虽然初步实验证据表明它们空中的视觉很差, 但海豚跳高从训练员手中取小鱼的准确性却提供了相反的传闻证据。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Such variation can no doubt be explained with reference to the habitats in which individual species have developed.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问,这种差异可以用个别物种生长的生境来解释。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: For example, vision is obviously more useful to species inhabiting clear open waters than to those living in turbid rivers and flooded plains.
sentences.zh: 例如,与生活在动荡的河流和洪水平原中的物种相比,远景对居住在清晰的公海上的物种显然更有用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The South American boutu and Chinese beiji, for instance, appear to have very limited vision, and the Indian susus are blind, their eyes reduced to slits that probably allow them to sense only the direction and intensity of light.
sentences.zh: 例如,南美的蒙图和中国的美食似乎视力非常有限,印度的苏斯目瞎,眼睛被割裂,可能只让他们感觉到光的方向和强度。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Although the senses of taste and smell appear to have deteriorated, and vision in water appears to be uncertain, such weaknesses are more than compensated for by cetaceans’ well-developed acoustic sense.
sentences.zh: 虽然品味和嗅觉似乎已经恶化,水中的视觉似乎不确定,但这种弱点远远不能用鲸目动物发展良好的声学感来弥补。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Most species are highly vocal, although they vary in the range of sounds they produce, and many forage for food using echolocation.
sentences.zh: 大多数物种的声响很大,尽管它们产生的声音范围不同,而且许多饲料使用回声定位作为食物。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Large baleen whales primarily use the lower frequencies and are often limited in their repertoire.
sentences.zh: 大白鲸主要使用较低频率,而且其分布范围往往有限。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Notable exceptions are the nearly song-like choruses of bowhead whales in summer and the complex, haunting utterances of the humpback whales.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的例外是夏天的弓头鲸几乎像歌一样的花环,以及座头鲸的复杂、令人困扰的言论。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Toothed species in general employ more of the frequency spectrum, and produce a wider variety of sounds, than baleen species (though the sperm whale apparently produces a monotonous series of high-energy clicks and little else).
sentences.zh: 一般而言,牙类的频率范围比白鲸的频率范围要多,产生的声音也比白鲸的频率范围要广(虽然精鲸显然会产生一连串高能量点击,其他的则很少)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Some of the more complicated sounds are clearly communicative, although what role they may play in the social life and ‘culture’ of cetaceans has been more the subject of wild speculation than of solid science.
sentences.zh: 更复杂的声音中有些声音显然具有沟通性,尽管他们在社会生活和鲸目动物的 " 文化 " 中可能扮演什么角色,但更像是野生投机而不是固态科学的话题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。
